messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Which uses does the nanoScan3 manual list as impermissible use of the laser scanner, apart from the impermissible ambient conditions?

response.text: Quali usi il manuale del nanoScan3 elenca come usi non consentiti dello scanner laser, oltre alle condizioni ambientali non consentite?
